title: Do Speech BCIs Need Larger Models? Rethinking Neural Decoding beyond Scaling
abstract: arXiv:2610.23175v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Recent speech brain-computer interfaces (BCIs) increasingly rely on large models and complex multi-stage pipelines for neural decoding. However, in speech BCI, where training data are scarce, noisy, and expensive to collect, the benefits of model scaling remain unclear. This work revisits a fundamental question: are large models truly necessary for accurate neural decoding? We propose BEST (Brain-Encoding-Speech-Text), a two-stage framework for efficient neural-to-text decoding. Instead of relying on large generative models or phoneme-centric pipelines, BEST introduces hierarchical intermediate representations and a compact speech-oriented decoder that directly maps neural activity to text. This design preserves essential structure while significantly reducing computational cost, enabling robust generalization in low-resource settings and practical deployment under constrained resources. translated_title: 语音脑机接口需要更大的模型吗？超越规模化的神经解码反思
translated_abstract: 近年来，语音脑机接口（BCI）日益依赖大型模型和复杂的多阶段流水线来进行神经解码。然而，在语音BCI领域中，训练数据稀缺、噪声大且采集成本高昂，模型规模化的收益仍不明确。本工作重新审视了一个根本问题：大型模型对于精确的神经解码真的必要吗？我们提出了BEST（Brain-Encoding-Speech-Text），一个用于高效神经到文本解码的两阶段框架。BEST不依赖大型生成模型或以音素为中心的流水线，而是引入了分层中间表示和一个紧凑的面向语音的解码器，直接将神经活动映射为文本。这种设计在保留关键结构的同时显著降低了计算成本，使其能够在低资源环境中实现稳健的泛化，并在资源受限的条件下进行实际部署。在Brain-to-Text '24和'25基准测试中，BEST……
tldr: 本文提出两阶段框架BEST，通过分层中间表示和紧凑的语音导向解码器直接将神经活动映射为文本，证明在数据稀缺的语音脑机接口任务中，无需依赖大型模型即可实现高效、低成本且泛化性强的神经解码。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes BEST, a two-stage framework using hierarchical intermediate representations and a compact speech-oriented decoder to directly map neural activity to text, demonstrating that accurate and efficient neural decoding in low-resource speech BCIs does not require large models.
